checks.name: Signup password visibility is explicit, accessible and off by default
Email signup is default; password confirmation prevents an invalid provider request
Signup sends one verification message into a separate waiting panel that fits narrow screens
Verification resend waits for the cooldown without sending duplicate requests
Continue opens a compact login; an unverified email still creates neither a Vuga session nor local PIN
Provider throttling shows the retry countdown and suppresses further requests until the wait ends
Resending requests only the account password; bad credentials and provider failure remain recoverable
A pending resend cannot submit twice, and success starts a new cooldown
An already verified email switches back to login without another verification message
Forgot-password opens an email-only reset form and returns to login without changing the device PIN
Verified email login stores account identity and a separate hashed local PIN, never password or refresh token
Local PIN works offline without invoking phone login or email-password sign-in
Password reset uses generic wording and leaves local PIN unchanged
Explicit local unlink leaves cloud account, local child and PIN intact
Relinking checks existing local PIN before any cloud login and preserves that PIN
Email recovery refuses a different Vuga identity and leaves linked identity and PIN intact
Fresh matching email authentication permits local PIN recovery
Email settings fit a mobile viewport and cloud deletion requests password, not local PIN
Failed deletion keeps local account; explicit retry clears only cloud linkage and preserves child/PIN
Legacy phone flow remains explicitly accessible
A pending legacy phone request disables switching to email until it finishes
